hardening.minimized_reason: Headless-only JVM omits X11/desktop-window support, jmods, demos and the OCI entrypoint; font/image rendering and JIT remain.
hardening.pledge_reason: Built-in capability groups deny operations until root-held allowance files grant them; this is independent of the service form.

changes.what: Omit jmods, demos and the OCI entrypoint.
changes.why: Keep the runtime and supported development packages without unused distribution artifacts.

changes.what: Ignore environment-controlled startup options, refuse effective-root initialization and restrict native access and object deserialization.
changes.why: Enforce runtime policy within the JVM so application-controlled relaunches cannot discard it.

changes.what: Build headless-only with explicit fontconfig dependency.
changes.why: Remove desktop-window support while preserving server font and image rendering.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi ships equivalent policy and installed-package probes verify it; review before retiring this overlay.
